reviews.text: This is the second time we have used Libby to look after our two cats. She is so good, the cats love her. I would highly recommend her services. 5 Stars.

We were nervous to leave our indoor only cat to go on holiday but she was in great hands with Libby. We had daily photos/videos/updates and we felt really relaxed knowing she was ok back home. Libby has since also covered a shorter weekend break for us and we’ll continue to book her as we know we can trust her ❤️

Libby has looked after our Cats a few times now, and has always been great. We get updates and pics of the Cats while we are away, which is lovely and gives you confidence that all is ok. 100% recommend!

Great Service Libby is very easy to get along with and to trust with your fur balls. My 2 cats was very happy and she also sent me photos for reasurence while I was away. I will definitely use again. Thank you 😊 …

This is the first time we have used a cat sitter for our 3 cats. We were really anxious at the thought of leaving them for a few days while we went on a family holiday. We didn't need to worry at all. Libby was really professional, caring and she kept us updated with pictures of them. When we returned from our holiday, our cats were so chilled and had been taken good care of. We would definitely use Happy Cat again and recommend to others.
Thanks again Libby!
Libby & Phoebe gave brilliant care and attention to our kittens. I would thoroughly recommend and will definitely be using again.

Libby and jess were fantastic looking after my cat snowy while I was away for 4 weeks. I use to get regular updates and pictures every day. They played with snowy and gave her so much love that made snowy so happy that she never felt alone,The price was reasonable. I would recommend jess and libby to all my friends and family.
Jess took great care of our cats and house, we'll definitely be using Happy Cat again.

If I could give Libby more than 5 stars I would .I was super anxious to leave my cat Milo with anyone ,as I have never done it before and after a long time of me doing thorough research on the best cat sitter for him I found Happy cat .I looked at the reviews and they filled me with so much confidence because of how consistent the good reviews from previous customers were ,and I definitely made the right decision because from the moment I met Libby for the initial consultation where she asked me questions about milo all my worries melted away .she was so friendly,professional and just so genuine ,you can tell she has your cats best interest at heart .She did everything I asked this included pictures updates which put me at ease  .To find a cat sitter who your confident to not only look after your cat but also allow into your home is a huge daunting but I needn’t have worried.She made my trip away enjoyable, because I wasn’t worried about anything.I would highly recommend her and I will definitely be using Libby to cat sit again .Milo is such a nervous cat but he wasn’t around her. I feel animals can sense great people .Thank you Libby I can’t express how happy I am that I found you ,and how delighted I am with the service you provided for both me & Milo

I’m thrilled to have found such a wonderful cat sitter.
Really stress free and easy to arrange.
Whilst I was away she sent me updates including photos and even watered my plant. The cats loved her.
I have not been away for 3 years as I had anxiety about the care of the cats and this whole service and experience has really helped with that. I can’t recommend Libby enough!! Thank you

Libby and Jess were both amazing!! Great communication and sent daily pictures whilst I was away. They left my place spotless and cleaned everything when I returned home. I would recommend them to anyone and would defo use them again!! Thank you so much for putting my mind at ease whilst I was away.  😁 …

We would highly recommend Happy Cat.  Libby was great when we contacted her to book and Jess was really great with our cat whilst we were away.  It was great to know our cat was fed, had some attention and the house was being checked on too.  Jess was great with communication with us whilst we were away, sending photos and videos and dealing with any packages that arrived.

The first time I’ve ever used a cat sitter and I am absolutely thrilled that I found Libby. Communication was excellent and the cat was relaxed with her too. Will definitely be using her service again and 100% recommend her.
Libby recently fed my two newly adopted rescue cats while I was on holiday.  I was very happy with her services and have already booked her again for my next holiday.
Thoroughly recommended !

We have had Libby look after our cat a couple of times now and wouldn't hesitate to recommend her to others. We have had friendly, easy experiences meeting her beforehand to go through our cat's needs and Libby is very accommodating and understanding. Libby gets all the information she might need so you feel confident that your cat is in good hands. She updates you with pictures, if you like, so you know your cat is safe and well. She is reliable and trustworthy and I will go on to utilise Happy Cat when we need. Thank you Libby!

I'm so relieved to have found such a great cat sitter. Libby has looked after my boys twice now and put me at ease knowing they are in safe hands whilst i'm away. The regular updates and photos also help! Would highly recommend Happy Cat.

We have been using Libby (happy cat) for a number of years. She is so caring of our 4 cats.  2 of them are normally shy but they all turn up for their food when Libby arrives. We appreciate the photos and updates. Last year we had issues with our cat flap but she kindly helped to sort it out.
She is respectful of our property and looks after our home. We would highly recommend Happy Cat.

We followed a recommendation from a friend of a friend for Libby, and had her look after our cats while we were away for two weeks, and she was wonderful. We have health concerns with our boy, and she really made us feel reassured that he was in good hands and kept us in the loop with regular updates. We will 100% hire her again the next time we travel. She is professional and our cats liked her too (even the shy boy). Thanks Libby!

My mum has always looked after my cat, Jack, when my husband and I have been away, but she’s is now in her 80’s and is no longer mobile enough. As Jack has to have medication, I was worried about leaving him with someone else. He’s also elderly.

I found Happy Cat by just doing a Google Search for cat sitters in the area. Libby came back to me straight away and arranged a house visit (I tried another cat sitter before I found Happy Cat and they were not willing to do a home visit and said they’d “put me on a waiting list”!).

I felt confident in Libby as soon as I met her. She put my mind at ease and we ran through Jack’s routine and she made notes.

Libby was absolutely wonderful and kept me regularly updated with photos. I was worried Jack would be anxious with a stranger but he was fine and Libby sent me a bonus video of them playing together. It meant we could enjoy our holiday. A shout out to Jess too as she fed Jack in the evenings.

I couldn’t recommend Happy Cat highly enough!
